cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll talk about last night's rent argument. Start there, please, not with a summary of everything I've done this year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole year matters. You've been pulling away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It does. But that's a conclusion. Ask one question, and let me finish the answer before you explain it back to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you going to move out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I packed a bag. It's still upstairs. Please don't turn that into a departure date; let the fact sit here for a minute.

reason: Preserve the original's passing disclosure progression while removing detached professional phrases and making A correct the form and interpretation of the one allowed answer.
